message: handled-effects list cannot be checked: the body calls a value the compiler could not resolve
help: name the function at the call, or widen the handled list: an unresolved call may perform any effect, and reaching one with no handler aborts the process

message: `main` reaches operation `log` of effect `Console` with no handler: the process would write `axiom: unhandled effect` and exit 71 there - main -> viaDirect -> usesLog
label: reaches `Console` with nothing handling it
help: install one - `(handle BODY (E) HANDLER)` around the call - or, if an unhandled operation of this effect is a deliberate abort as `Assert`'s is, write `;@axiom:unhandled(trap)` above its `effect` declaration
